crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Behold, I have given Jericho into your hand, with its king and the mighty men of valor.
Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed. Take all the warriors with you, and arise, go up to Ai.…
There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.
He hanged the king of Ai on a tree until the evening. At sundown, Joshua commanded, and they took his body down from…

people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel
